note: G03 interactions: x:w + z:h with no margins. x:w is the product column. Neither z nor h has its margin in the formula, so R codes both by indicators of every level (not contrasts): 12 columns zp:hh1, zq:hh1, zr:hh1, zp:hh2, ..., zr:hh4, one per cell, each row in exactly one. With the intercept X has 14 columns of rank 13 (the cells sum to the intercept), and brms's centred columns (Xc, 13) have rank 12: the design is rank deficient by construction and the model is identified by its priors only; every cell has a row (no zero column). brms's posterior_linpred on the fitted and new rows equals b_Intercept + X b + r_g (+ offsets) built from the columns described, to 2e-15 at every frozen point. Data: tier_g1, seed 2211, 36 rows.
